shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; sed -n '1,240p' ticket.md; if [ -f round-brief.md ]; then echo '--- round-brief.md ---'; sed -n '1,240p' round-brief.md; fi; echo '--- target/.lore/dod.md ---'; sed -n '1,260p' target/.lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; echo '--- brief ---'; sed -n '1,520p' round-brief.md; echo '--- package ---'; sed -n '1,220p' target/package.json; echo '--- changed files ---'; git -C target diff --stat; git -C target diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; git log -3 --oneline; echo '--- brief rest ---'; sed -n '20,220p' ../round-brief.md; echo '--- test anchors ---'; sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '300,430p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '540,590p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; echo '--- specs links ---'; rg -n 'works without|calls all hooks|error path|receives the last|modifies user|receives user|replaces system|receives collected|not called when stream|called with session|validated by' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; echo '--- source ---'; rg -n -C 8 'beforeSession' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "wc -l ../round-brief.md; sed -n '1,80p' ../round-brief.md; sed -n '80,180p' ../round-brief.md; echo '--- acceptance test ---'; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts; echo '--- changelog/spec config ---'; sed -n '1,80p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; sed -n '1,80p' CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n -C 3 'validation|rejection|tool input|schema-invalid|weather' specs src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | head -120; git show --stat --oneline HEAD; git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -i -C 2 'inputSchema|schema-invalid|invalid.*input|validation message|malformed|tool.*valid' specs/*.md specs/**/*.md | head -160; sed -n '330,365p' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md; sed -n '455,470p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '555,615p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -i -C 2 'inputSchema|schema-invalid|invalid.*input|validation message|malformed|tool.*valid' specs --glob '*.md' | head -200; rg -n 'validation-rejection|validation' specs/hal-engine-*/*.md | head -80; git show HEAD"'^:specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md | rg -n '"'works without|calls all hooks|error path|receives the last|modifies user|receives user|replaces system|receives collected|not called when stream|called with session'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs; sed -n '1,140p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -B 2 -A 2 'validated by' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -100"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/|adrs/' src --glob '*.{ts,tsx}' | head -80; rg -n 'validated by' . --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.js' --glob '*.mjs' | head -80"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs; rg -n 'repoint-spec-anchors' package.json scripts README.md .github 2>/dev/null | head -40; git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npm run spec:names -- --fix'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'validation failure becomes' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; rg -n 'works without|calls all hooks|error path calls|receives the last|modifies user|receives user|replaces system|receives collected|not called when stream|called with session' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short; git diff --stat; git diff -- specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; git diff --check'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npm run spec:names'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git status --short; git diff --stat; git diff --name-only'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "docs: repair spec test anchors" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch; git log -1 --oneline; git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...@{upstream}'
